title: 我是间谍 · I'm a Spy
description: He can keep a secret, but not the way he feels when you walk by. A playful love song about trying to stay cool, giving yourself away, and taking someone's hand beneath a sky full of stars.
caption: I'm a cool guy, don't you cry. Take my hand and we can fly.
